summary: Run the sidebar filter latency benchmark once in the desktop dark browser case, retain filter behavior in every viewport and theme, and omit two scheme-only strict-play aliases already covered by the runner's scheme override.

replay.detail: Story test coverage only; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The full strict case set explicitly selects the desktop dark filter benchmark and omits only NoGreenAllStatesLight and FooterWidthBudgetLight; both remain available in Storybook, and their base stories still run both widths and schemes. Expected case counts, omission summaries and shard coverage use the same selection. The calibrated 30-sample filter/reference phases, 3x p90 budget and 4x busy-wait negative control are unchanged. FilterBehavior retains filter/unfilter behavior, retained identity and rebuild-control checks in every outer viewport and scheme.
